requirements.statement: CC.EN is a read/write bit with reset value zero; a legal zero-to-one write enables normal controller operation.
preconditions: CSTS.RDY is zero for a defined zero-to-one write

requirements.statement: While CC.EN is zero, the controller shall not process commands or post Completion Queue entries.
Clearing CC.EN from one to zero initiates a Controller Reset whose Controller Level Reset does not affect AQA, ASQ, or ACQ.
preconditions: CC.EN changes from one to zero in normal operation

requirements.statement: The Admin Queue properties AQA, ASQ, and ACQ are only allowed to be modified when CC.EN is zero.
After CC.EN is set, CSTS.RDY indicates readiness to process commands; after CC.EN is cleared, RDY clears once the controller is ready to be re-enabled.
preconditions: Normal operation without shutdown or fatal error

assumptions.statement: The environment makes only defined host writes. Enabling occurs only with RDY=0, clearing EN occurs only with RDY=1, and commands are processed only after RDY=1. The source's host recommendation to wait for RDY is used as an environment assumption.

During normal operation, continuously enabled controller-ready and reset-complete steps eventually occur; represented by weak fairness for ControllerReady and ControllerResetDone. This abstracts unspecified real-time bounds.

AQA/ASQ/ACQ are represented by two distinct opaque configurations. At most two processed and two posted events are tracked per enable interval; counts are ghost history, reset when a new Controller Reset starts.
The model starts in a disabled, ready-to-enable normal state. Initial Admin Queue configuration is nondeterministic because it is not specified on these source pages.

exclusions.statement: Controller and NVM Subsystem Shutdown exceptions on the cited pages are outside this normal-operation model.
Fatal controller error status and error recovery are outside this model.
CAP.TO timing, elapsed time, and timeout behavior are outside this untimed model.
Transport-specific registers and state are outside this model.

Full Controller Level Reset effects on I/O queues, internal state, and data integrity are outside this five-variable abstraction; only Admin Queue property preservation and RDY completion are represented.
Undefined-result host writes and commands submitted before RDY are excluded from the defined-behavior model.

unresolved_dependencies: The detailed Controller Level Reset effects are delegated by Figure 41 to section 3.7.2, which is outside the supplied pages.
The timing definition is delegated by Figure 42 to CAP.TO in sections 3.5.3 and 3.5.4, which are outside the supplied pages.
